headline: 9 of 9 with no wipes in 69 minutes, four guild records

mvp.headline: 91 average across all nine bosses, no deaths, tanking plus soaks
why: Top average parse of the night (91) with nothing below 76 on any of the nine bosses
Tanked throughout without dying and soaked 2 Poison Bolts on Huhuran
Full consumables on every pull: Mongoose, Giants, Armor, Firewater, Titans, Zanza and Stamina, all 9 of 9

also.text: 49 dispels, more than double the next best (Mohg 20)
91 average as dps, 96 or better on four bosses, no deaths
90 average as tank, 90 or better on seven bosses, no deaths

overview: 9 of 9 with no wipes in 69 minutes, a touch quicker than the guild median through the zone. Only 6 of the 40 meet the site's strict regular cutoff, but most of the rest are familiar names: 14 have 5 or fewer logged raids and 7 more have 15 or fewer. The raid still set four guild records: Huhuran in 33 seconds (best 35), Twin Emperors in 149 (best 150), Ouro in 73 (best 74) and C'Thun in 205 (best 210). Fankriss tied the record at 33.

Only 5 of the 17 deaths came on bosses, all on Skeram (3) and Viscidus (2); the other 12 were trash. Skeram went in with no world buffs on anyone, then the raid was fully buffed from the Bug Trio on. Interrupts were good all night (7 of 11 Arcane Explosions, 3 of 4 Great Heals, the only Huhuran Frenzy) and C'Thun's Eye Beams stayed at a quarter of the guild usual.

wentWell.text: Huhuran in 33 seconds, a new guild record (best 35, median 53), with no deaths where a kill usually loses 3 to Poison Bolt. The one Frenzy was tranquilized.
Twin Emperors in 149 seconds, a new guild record (best 150, median 257), with no deaths and no Heal Brother.
Ouro in 73 seconds, a new guild record (best 74, median 108), with 3 Sand Blasts against a usual near 40 per kill.
C'Thun in 205 seconds, a new guild record (best 210, median 352), with no deaths and 14 Eye Beam hits against a usual near 75.
Fankriss in 33 seconds, tying the guild record (median 47), with no deaths on 30k raid DPS.

notes.text: Skeram went in with no world buffs on anyone (40 snapshots, all empty). From the Trio on, 38 of 40 had Rallying Cry and Spirit of Zandalar, 33 Songflower, around 30 of each Dire Maul buff and 24 Sayge's Fortune. Raid DPS was still right on the guild usual (9710 against 9729).

Arcane Explosion hit 85 times (2.13 per raider against a guild usual of 1.26) across 37 raiders. 11 casts started and 7 were interrupted. Two healers died to it in the final second of the 69 second kill, so the healing never noticed.
Tochopolvo died to melee at 0:24 with only 48 overkill, the first death of the night. Mind controls (5) came at the usual rate and Earth Shock did almost nothing (7.8k).
68 seconds with no deaths, against a median of 83. Yauj's fear landed 42 times (1.05 per raider against a usual 1.47).

Toxic Vapors did 89k (half of all damage taken, 1308 per second) against a guild usual of 232 per second. 20 raiders stood in it, so Kri died in a bad spot. Nobody died to it, but a guild kill usually takes a tenth of this.
Yauj started 4 Great Heals and 3 were interrupted, with no healing landing on the bosses.
59 seconds with no deaths, against a median of 74. Whirlwind hit 162 times (4.05 per raider against a usual 4.92) and a kill usually loses nearly 2 people to it.

33 seconds, tying the guild record (median 47), with no deaths on 30k raid DPS against a usual 23k. Only 4 Mortal Wound stacks landed on one raider and 3 players were Entangled. No worm ever got going.
120 seconds against a median of 122. Poison Bolt Volley hit 541 times (13.5 per raider against a usual 18.3). Eînherjer dispelled 29 Volleys, more than triple the next best.

Both deaths were Toxin clouds: Broimtiny at 0:29 with 1487 overkill and Marulock at 1:53 with 39. A kill usually loses 0.64 there. Only 1 Nature Protection Potion was drunk where the guild usually drinks around 9.

33 seconds, a new guild record (best 35, median 53), with no deaths where a kill usually loses over 3 to Poison Bolt. Frenzy came once and Punintended tranquilized it, the only Tranq of the fight. 16 raiders soaked the 29 Poison Bolts and 8 Nature Protection Potions were drunk.
Parse median 90 against a usual 80. The burn was so short that volleys soaked ran at 0.73 per raider against a usual 2.01. Nothing had time to go wrong.

149 seconds, a new guild record (best 150, median 257), with no deaths where a kill usually loses around 2 to melee and Shadow Bolt. Blizzard caught 6 hits (0.15 per raider against a usual 0.98) and exploding bugs 7 (0.18 against 0.4). No Heal Brother landed, so the emperors stayed apart all fight.
Parse median 86 against a usual 80. Harrylarry 99, Lookdown and Valethia 98.

73 seconds, a new guild record (best 74, median 108), with no deaths where a kill usually loses over 4 to melee and Sand Blast. Sand Blast hit 3 times (0.08 per raider against a usual 0.64), so the raid stayed out of the cone and the tanks held every swap. Sweeps (62) ran at the usual rate.
Parse median 91 against a usual 75. Gertggs 99, Harrylarry 98, Hjärterkung 97.

205 seconds, a new guild record (best 210, median 352), with no deaths where a kill usually loses over 2 to Eye Beam alone plus one each to Glare and Mind Flay. Eye Beam hit 14 times (0.35 per raider against a usual 1.28) across 10 raiders, and only 7 raiders ever had to go to the stomach (38 visits against a usual rate over three times higher).
Parse median 80 against a usual 60. Ground Rupture was the top damage as usual and Digestive Acid did 19k. With that few beams and stomach trips the healers were never under pressure.
